lines: han
林浅，你早知道？
Lin Qian, did you know?
lin
见过一次。我没报告，是我判断错了。
I saw it once. I didn't report it. That was my mistake.
segments.label: 次日 · 工作安排与情况说明

lines: han
如实记录。检刺暂停现场工作，安排评估。案子由许未接着复核。
Record it accurately. Jian Ci is off field duty pending assessment. Xu Wei will continue the case review.
caller
她说话含含糊糊的，站不稳。
Her speech is slurred. She is unsteady.
caller
对，还站着……
Yes, she is still standing...
segments.label: 9月3日 · 急救通话节选

lines: caller
她倒了！
She has fallen!
segments.label: 同一通话 · 随后

lines: zhou
通话、画面和证人说法对上了。异常在跌倒之前。
The call, footage, and witness account align. The symptoms came before the fall.
lin
把这一段交许未，一起复核。
Send this to Xu Wei for the combined review.
segments.label: 通话、现场影像与证人信息核对

lines: xu
这些表现与后来的检查相符。病程已经在跌倒前开始。
Those symptoms fit the subsequent findings. The clinical course had begun before the fall.
xu
不能把这次发病，全归到后来那一跤。
The later fall cannot account for the whole illness.
segments.label: 结合住院检查与原始病理复核

lines: xu
综合现场、病程和病理，支持那次颈部暴力造成血管损伤，继而导致致命脑梗死。
Taken together, the circumstances, clinical course, and pathology support the neck assault causing vascular injury and a fatal cerebral infarction.
han
依据逐项写清，随案移送。
Set out each basis clearly and submit it with the case.
segments.label: 补充调查及综合复核后

lines: mother
她说疼，我还叫她睡一觉就好。
She said it hurt. I told her to sleep it off.
lin
您不知道她经历了什么。这不是您的错。
You didn't know what had happened to her. This wasn't your fault.
segments.label: 接待室 · 告知进展

lines: zhou
原始资料、提取记录，都在。
The original material and extraction records are all included.
